title: Geometric spectral pooling did not improve PPG respiratory-rate estimates across intensive-care and perioperative cohorts
abstract: Geometric PPG spectral pooling did not establish lower respiratory-rate error than arithmetic pooling: BIDMC gain -0.015 breaths/min (95% CI -0.179 to 0.143); independent CapnoBase gain 0.047 (-0.145 to 0.272). Fixed label-free estimators were tested in53 BIDMC and42 CapnoBase records. Geometric pooling also failed to improve over a median of three modulation peak rates. Subdominant spectral information may be useful, but this fixed consensus rule did not establish an accuracy benefit. Independent-cohort testing used previously examined datasets, not untouched confirmation.
